name: Joiakim
overview: Joiakim is identified in Scripture as a high priest during the time of Nehemiah and Ezra, serving as a key religious leader in the post-exilic community. Nehemiah 12 highlights his priestly lineage, noting that he was the son of Jeshua and the father of Eliashib, situating him within the priestly succession. His tenure is marked by the presence of other prominent priests, emphasizing his role in maintaining the spiritual leadership of Israel during the restoration period.
